role: The first-person hand pass: EntityRenderer.renderHand and ItemRenderer.renderItemInFirstPerson with the bare arm (ModelBiped right arm box), flat items extruded by renderItemIn2D, held blocks via block_item_model, swing, equip, eat/drink, bow pull and sword block, lit by RenderHelper's two standard item lights and drawn through the entity rasterizer over a cleared depth buffer; for recorded scenes and for the live client.
gpu: line 356, function raster_hand_draw: malloc of a full-frame depth buffer every frame
lines 523-575: file reads (read_all, last_line, raster_hand_read_rgba) with malloc on the frame path for recorded scenes
notes: Called from raster.c's draw_worldfx for recorded scenes (raster_hand_scene) and from play/play.c for the live client (raster_hand_draw, raster_hand_item_lookup, raster_hand_read_rgba). The modelview is built with renderstate.c's rs_gl_rotate/rs_gl_translate in vanilla GL call order. The arm uses fixed idle ModelBiped angles (first_person_arm, lines 200-221). Recordings without a hand block fall back to an idle player holding the HUD's selected stack. EntityPlayerSP and EntityLivingBase member names were matched by grep and the struct fields in raster_hand.h, not traced through the source line by line. lane/entrender: the enchant glint on pass 0 (texture matrix, GL_EQUAL, unlit), the glint leaving its colour set. lane/rlasync: raster_hand_item_lookup reads its table through itemtab.c (one converted copy a process) instead of a static jval tree parsed per view.
